title: dryopteris eatonii
intro: Dryopteris eatonii, commonly known as Eaton's fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help to reduce oxidative stress and inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Eaton's fern include acting as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant agent, which may aid in the treatment of various health conditions such as arthritis and other inflammatory diseases. The bioactive constituents present in Eaton's fern include flavonoids and other polyphenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
